subject: Initial SOC 2 Type II evidence request — audit period clarification & minimal share plan
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme-payments.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: security-team@acme-payments.com
Date: 2025-06-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II request — audit period & minimal evidence asks

Hi Mateo —

We're starting our procurement review for the payments integration and need a quick intake for your SOC 2 Type II coverage. Can you please confirm the following and share a minimal set of artifacts by next Wednesday (2025-06-11):

- Do you have a current SOC 2 Type II report for the control period Jan 1, 2024 — Dec 31, 2024? If the full report is not available for external distribution, would you provide a signed bridge letter that attests to unchanged control coverage and an expected delivery window for the report?
- Minimal artifacts we typically need (examples): policy excerpts (retention, access control), sample access logs (one-week extract), change-management snapshot (recent release approvals), and an extract of retention settings for customer data. A small CSV of anonymized audit log rows is fine.
- Can you provide a secure transfer option (presigned S3, secure Drive folder) and any guidance on redaction?

We want to keep the ask scoped — if you have a short template we can accept (bridge letter + summary + 1 week of anonymized logs), that would unblock procurement.

Thanks,
Sarah Li
Head of Security Operations
Acme Payments

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-03T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request — audit period & minimal evidence asks

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the clear list; happy to help and keep this low-friction. Short answers up front:

- Report availability: We do have a SOC 2 Type II attestation covering 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31. We typically share the executive summary and auditor-issued bridge letter for prospect reviews; the full report can be shared under NDA/secure transfer or via your procurement portal.

- Minimal deliverables we can provide immediately: 1) bridge letter signed by our compliance lead confirming control scope and audit period, 2) a 2-page SOC 2 executive summary (control list + auditor), and 3) an anonymized one-week sample of access logs and event telemetry (CSV) with guidance on columns included.

- Transfer options: we can provide a presigned S3 upload link and a pre-provisioned, access-limited Drive folder. See attached quick instructions for presigned transfers. Redaction guidance: we will anonymize PII and customer identifiers — we will keep request IDs, UTC timestamps, user-role, action, and object-type columns for your review.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary_v1.pdf, presigned-transfer-instructions.txt (see attachment stubs).

If that scope works, we'll send the bridge letter and the sample extracts by EOD tomorrow (2025-06-04). Also included below is a short suggested reply template you can use internally to accept the bridge + samples in lieu of the full report: 

--- suggested external reply template (copy/paste) ---
Thanks — Acme accepts Redwood's SOC 2 Type II bridge letter and the provided anonymized telemetry sample for initial procurement evaluation. Please proceed with the presigned share.
--- end template ---

Next steps:
- Please confirm you accept the bridge letter + samples for the initial review.
- If so, share a secure transfer target (we will provide presigned links by tomorrow).

Best,
Mateo
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Security
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-03T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request — audit period & minimal evidence asks

Mateo / Kim —

I'll pull the artifacts and coordinate owners:
- Naomi: bridge letter (draft ready), redwood_soc2_summary_v1.pdf (final), presigned instructions (ops).
- Kim: generate anonymized one-week access/event log extract (CSV) — will scrub PII and customer IDs; will include UTC timestamp, actor_role, action, object_type, request_id; sample size ~5k rows unless they ask for smaller.

Target: send presigned link + bridge letter + summary + sample log by 2025-06-04 17:00 PDT. If procurement needs a smaller sample, we can reduce to ~500 rows.

I'll add a short cover note for the transfer explaining columns and redaction.

Naomi
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme-payments.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: security-team@acme-payments.com
Date: 2025-06-05T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request — audit period & minimal evidence asks

Hi Mateo / Naomi —

That plan works for us. Acme accepts the bridge letter + executive summary + anonymized one-week log sample for initial procurement gating. A couple of quick asks before you send:

- Can the sample include at least one example of a successful authentication event and one elevated-privilege change? Those help our reviewers validate control coverage.
- Please include a single-line statement in the bridge letter about retention windows for customer audit logs (e.g., "Customer-facing audit logs retained for minimum X days") if possible.

Once we receive the presigned link, we'll download the artifacts and confirm next steps. If we require the full SOC 2 report later, we'll send an NDA/secure request.

Thanks — appreciated the quick turnaround.
Sarah
Head of Security Operations, Acme Payments
